## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `scim-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Register a machine-to-machine (M2M) application

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [Asgardeo Console](https://console.asgardeo.io/). -->
2. Select **Applications** in the left navigation menu.
3. Select **New Application** and select **M2M Application**.
4. In the **Name** field, enter a unique name to identify your application (for example, `Ballerina SCIM Connector`).
5. <!-- manual: In the Name field, enter a unique name to identify your application (for example, Ballerina SCIM Connector). -->
6. Select **Register** to complete the registration.

2. <!-- manual: Authorize the SCIM2 API resources and select the required scopes (permissions), such as: -->
3. <!-- manual: internal_user_mgt_list: List and filter users -->

8. <!-- manual: internal_group_mgt_view: View group details -->

12. Select **Update** to save the authorization settings.
